targets.rawSql:
WITH bucketed_hosts AS (
  SELECT
    host,
    run_id,
    node_id,
    unixtime AS bucket_start,
    LEAD(unixtime) OVER (
      PARTITION BY run_id,
      node_id
      ORDER BY
        unixtime
    ) AS bucket_end
  FROM
    hosts
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ${time_meaning:sqlstring} = 'frame' THEN $__unixEpochGroup(latencies.unixtime, $bucket_interval, NULL)
    ELSE $__unixEpochGroup(latencies.unixtime, $bucket_interval, NULL) + AVG(latency)
  END as time,
  AVG(latency) as latency,
  bucketed_hosts.host,
  latencies.node_id
FROM
  latencies
  JOIN bucketed_hosts ON latencies.run_id = bucketed_hosts.run_id
  AND latencies.node_id = bucketed_hosts.node_id
  AND latencies.unixtime >= bucketed_hosts.bucket_start
  AND (
    bucketed_hosts.bucket_end is NULL
    OR latencies.unixtime < bucketed_hosts.bucket_end
  )
WHERE
  latencies.run_id in (${run_dir:sqlstring})
  AND latencies.node_id in (${node_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__unixEpochFilter(latencies.unixtime)
GROUP BY
  $__unixEpochGroup(latencies.unixtime, $bucket_interval, NULL),
  latencies.node_id,
  bucketed_hosts.host
ORDER BY
  time,
  latencies.node_id;

WITH lagged_values AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    node_id,
    IFO,
    unixtime as time,
    on_col,
    off,
    LAG(on_col) OVER (partition by run_id, node_id, ifo ORDER BY unixtime) AS prev_on,
    LAG(off) OVER (partition by run_id, node_id, ifo ORDER BY unixtime) AS prev_off
  FROM state_vector
)
SELECT
  node_id,
  IFO,
  time,
  CASE
    WHEN (on_col - prev_on > 0) AND (off - prev_off > 0) THEN 0.5
    WHEN (on_col - prev_on > 0) THEN 1
    WHEN (off - prev_off > 0) THEN 0
    ELSE -1
  END AS value
FROM lagged_values
where run_id in (${run_dir:sqlstring}) AND node_id in (${node_id:sqlstring}) AND $__unixEpochFilter(time)
ORDER BY
  time,
  ifo,
  node_id;

SELECT
  start_time + 315964782 AS "time",
  1 as live,
  node_id,
  CASE
    WHEN segment_def_id = 0 THEN 'H1'
    WHEN segment_def_id = 1 THEN 'L1'
    WHEN segment_def_id = 2 THEN 'V1'
  END as ifo
FROM
  segment
WHERE
  run_id in (${run_dir:sqlstring})
  AND node_id in (${node_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__unixEpochFilter(start_time + 315964782)
UNION
ALL
SELECT
  end_time + 315964782 AS "time",
  0 as live,
  node_id,
  CASE
    WHEN segment_def_id = 0 THEN 'H1'
    WHEN segment_def_id = 1 THEN 'L1'
    WHEN segment_def_id = 2 THEN 'V1'
  END as ifo
FROM
  segment
WHERE
  run_id in (${run_dir:sqlstring})
  AND node_id in (${node_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__unixEpochFilter(end_time + 315964782)
ORDER BY
  time,
  ifo,
  node_id;

SELECT
  node_id,
  $__unixEpochGroup(end_time+315964782, $bucket_interval, NULL) AS time,
  AVG(cohsnr) as cohsnr,
  AVG(cmbchisq) as cmbchisq,
  AVG(fap) as fap,
  AVG(far) as far,
  AVG(far_2h) as far_2h,
  AVG(far_1d) as far_1d,
  AVG(far_1w) as far_1w,
  AVG(mchirp) as mchirp,
  AVG(nullsnr) as nullsnr
FROM
  postcoh
WHERE run_id in (${run_dir:sqlstring})
AND node_id in (${node_id:sqlstring})
AND $__unixEpochFilter(end_time+315964782)
GROUP BY
  run_id,
  node_id,
  $__unixEpochGroup(end_time+315964782, $bucket_interval, NULL)
ORDER BY
  time

WITH time_series AS (
  SELECT
    generate_series(
      min(
        $__unixEpochGroup(latencies.unixtime, $bucket_interval)
      ) :: int,
      max(
        $__unixEpochGroup(latencies.unixtime, $bucket_interval)
      ) :: int,
      extract(
        epoch
        from
          interval ${bucket_interval:sqlstring}
      )
    ) AS time
  FROM
    latencies
  WHERE
    run_id in (${run_dir:sqlstring})
    AND node_id in (${node_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__unixEpochFrom() - extract(
      epoch
      from
        interval ${trigger_frequency:sqlstring}
    ) < unixtime
    AND unixtime < $__unixEpochTo()
),
frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    $__unixEpochGroup(unixtime, $bucket_interval) :: int AS time,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY node_id
      ORDER BY
        unixtime RANGE BETWEEN extract(
          epoch
          from
            interval ${trigger_frequency:sqlstring}
        ) PRECEDING
        AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS frequency,
    node_id
  FROM
    latencies
  WHERE
    run_id in (${run_dir:sqlstring})
    AND node_id in (${node_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__unixEpochFrom() - extract(
      epoch
      from
        interval ${trigger_frequency:sqlstring}
    ) < unixtime
    AND unixtime < $__unixEpochTo()
),
nodes AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT node_id
  FROM
    latencies
  WHERE
    run_id in (${run_dir:sqlstring})
    AND node_id in (${node_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__unixEpochFrom() - extract(
      epoch
      from
        interval ${trigger_frequency:sqlstring}
    ) < unixtime
    AND unixtime < $__unixEpochTo()
)
SELECT
  time_series.time,
  CASE
    WHEN frequencies.frequency < 10 THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(frequencies.frequency, NULL)
  END as frequency,
  nodes.node_id
FROM
  time_series
  CROSS JOIN nodes
  LEFT JOIN frequencies ON time_series.time = frequencies.time :: int
  AND nodes.node_id = frequencies.node_id
ORDER BY
  time_series.time,
  nodes.node_id;

list.definition:
SELECT runs.run_dir || '-DIR2RUN-' || runs.run_id from (
SELECT run_id, max(unixtime) as maxunixtime
FROM latencies
GROUP BY run_id
) b join runs on runs.run_id = b.run_id
where b.maxunixtime > $__unixEpochFrom()
ORDER BY runs.run_dir ASC;
